# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We pledge to make participation in this engineering hub a harassment-free, objective, and technically rigorous experience for everyone, regardless of background or experience level.

## Standards

- Focus on verifiable technical evidence, reproducible benchmarks, and constructive engineering feedback.
- Respect intellectual property, licensing terms (`MIT`), and workstation privacy.
- Unacceptable behavior including trolling, personal attacks, or publishing private system identifiers is strictly prohibited.

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive or unacceptable behavior may be reported to the repository maintainer at **`fnprospace@gmail.com`**.
